name: Ethereum
basis: each funding- or dividend-inclusive history is scaled to its own latest raw USD close

fundingForecast.displaySign: positive is earned by a perp long; negative is paid by a perp long

onchainSpot.preferenceBasis: all pages display separate CEX reported-volume and contract-backed DEX execution sections
onchainSpot.volumeSource: direct Binance, Bitget, Bybit, OKX, and Meteora venue APIs plus factory-verified PancakeSwap V3 pool-event volume indexed by DexScreener; DEX quote routes without indexed pool-event volume are excluded
onchainSpot.liquiditySource: direct CEX order books; direct Ethereum, Robinhood-chain, and PancakeSwap V3 quoter depth; direct Meteora pool state; and direct Jupiter executable round-trip quotes

peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: BTC 57.5% with 3/3 replicate support; SOL 26.7% with 3/3 replicate support; COIN 8.3% with 2/3 replicate support; XRP 7.5% with 2/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: Bitcoin
peers.reason: BTC is the closest return comparator to ETH: both are directly traded crypto assets whose returns are dominated by the same crypto market factor, liquidity conditions, and investor risk appetite for digital assets. It is preferred over equity proxies because it is the underlying asset rather than a corporate or leveraged wrapper.

peers.name: Solana
peers.reason: The closest economic peer after BTC: Solana is a direct substitute Layer-1 smart-contract platform with the same underlying exposure as ETH (decentralized compute and DeFi settlement) and shared input-cost and staking-yield dynamics. Its 90.531 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity is adequate and secondary to the economic overlap.

peers.name: Coinbase
peers.reason: Coinbase is a key supplier of ETH market infrastructure through trading, custody, and ETH staking, so its transaction and staking revenue are directly tied to ETH price and network activity, making it the closest listed equity. Weight is kept modest because it is a corporate equity proxy rather than the underlying and its 5.622 USD millions of liquidity is an execution constraint next to the directly traded crypto assets.

peers.name: XRP
peers.reason: XRP is kept as a small direct crypto comparator because it shares crypto trading venues, stablecoin quote infrastructure, custody channels, and US regulatory sensitivity with ETH. Its payments and settlement focus is less aligned with Ethereum smart contract demand than SOL, so it receives only a residual weight; its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 32.086 USD millions.

primary_index_hedge.name: Bitcoin
primary_index_hedge.reason: Bitcoin is the dominant crypto asset and the cleanest hedge for Ethereum exposure because it carries the largest share of the crypto-market systematic factor that drives most of ETH's return. It is also the most liquid instrument in the crypto set at 1888.107 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity versus ETH at 570.484 USD millions, so it is the practical vehicle for hedging generic crypto risk rather than a remote factor analogy.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
